case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for the constructive spirit in which you wrote. We value that, and we would like to build a steady, dependable relationship with Kalwisz.

Our data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We therefore see room to move on price and quality. Our proposal below is meant seriously, and it is built on reliable, punctual payment and steady call-offs that you can plan around:

Our proposal: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Thanks for the details on delivery and past prices; you make a fair point, but we really need you to fix your late payments. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

Our offer is a price of €49.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. I can accept the 1500 ppm target you want, but 500 EUR for a chargeback is too much, so I traded that down to 150 EUR. With this quality level, I can drop the price to 46.50 EUR per unit. Alternatively, with a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint: €46.50 per unit, a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.
